name: Rahad al-Mazaf
source:
The knight-captain who adopts and raises Luna. It is his evidence that frames Luna as the culprit for the attack on princess Jill in exchange for 50 gold pieces.

[Spoiler]
Rahad is secretly in league with the man in the white robes and is responsible for framing Luna with the letter which was meant for the vice-captain of the princess's guard. Luna is eventually forced to kill him twice. 
[/Spoiler]
